messages:
ana (partnerships): partners are asking for a single deprecation playbook for SDK/API changes (breaking fields, header changes, response envelopes). can we draft a vendor-facing checklist?

jules (eng): absolutely. suggest: 1) non-breaking extension if possible, 2) announce + docs, 3) canary, 4) full rollout.

marco (sdk): SDK owners want explicit runtime flags and a compatibility callback. propose `client.on('compat', handler)` and a `response.meta.compatibility` field.

leah (marketplace): vendors need a UI toggle per listing: "opt-in canary" and a clear grace period label. also need signed artifact for SDK compatibility.

ben (hw-partner): hardware partners care about binary compatibility and perf. request a shim crate and a small perf report template.

jules (eng): canary policy example: ```yaml
canary: {percent: 3, window_hours: 72, rollback_threshold_pct: 8}```

ana (partnerships): (typo) ana: also include communication plan: 2-week heads-up email, migration checklist, recorded webinar, and optional 1:1 office hours.

marco (sdk): snippet to handle incompatible responses: ```js
if (resp.meta && resp.meta.compatibility === 'incompatible') {
  client.emit('compat', resp.meta);
  return legacyParse(resp);
}
```

leah (marketplace): marketplace actions: banner on vendor console, audit log of toggles, telemetry `vendor.canary_assignment` and `compat.failure` per vendor-id.

jules (eng): infra tasks: routing priority = vendor opt-in > vendor percent > global percent. i'll land routing PR and telemetry by Fri.

notice-bot: [automated] Created draft template at https://internal.redwood/partner-playbooks/sdk-deprecation.md :white_check_mark:

ana (ana): action items: ana drafts one-pager, marco provides SDK code snippets, jules opens PR, leah wires console toggle. next sync Wed 11am PT.
